author: nickyeow

english.text: How did Barbara do on her driver's test yesterday?

jyutping: aa3 Barbara cam4 jat6 haau2 ce1 haau2 sing4 dim2 aa3？
text: 阿 Barbara 尋日考車考成點呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Now that I have finished this assignment I want to go to sleep, but I have to go to school.

jyutping: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3，soeng2 fan3 zan6 gaau3，daan6 hai6 jau6 jiu3 faan1 hok6⋯⋯
text: 我做完功課，想瞓陣覺，但係又要返學⋯⋯

author: nickyeow

english.text: While getting off the bus, she heard her name called.

jyutping: keoi5 jat1 lok6 ce1，zau6 teng1 dou2 jau5 jan4 giu3 keoi5 go3 ming4。
text: 佢一落車，就聽到有人叫佢個名。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He pretended not to hear his boss.

jyutping: keoi5 baan6 teng1 m4 dou3 lou5 sai3 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5。
text: 佢扮聽唔到老細同佢講嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My ballpoint pen just ran out of ink.

jyutping: ngo5 zi1 jyun4 zi2 bat1 mou5 saai3 mak6 laa3。
text: 我支原子筆冇晒墨喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'll come and see you at 3:00 p.m. on Sunday.

jyutping: ngo5 sing1 kei4 jat6 aan3 zau3 saam1 dim2 wui5 lai4 taam3 nei5。
text: 我星期日晏晝三點會嚟探你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please tell me how to get to the airport.

jyutping: m4 goi1 nei5 waa6 ngo5 teng1 gei1 coeng4 dim2 heoi3 aa1。
text: 唔該你話我聽機場點去吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She bought a vacuum cleaner at the supermarket.

jyutping: keoi5 hai2 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 dou6 maai5 zo2 bou6 kap1 can4 gei1。
text: 佢喺超級市場度買咗部吸塵機。

author: nickyeow

english.text: These days the number of women who don't want to change their family names even after they get married is increasing.

jyutping: ni1 paai4 jyu6 lai4 jyu6 do1 neoi5 jan2 git3 zo2 fan1 dou1 m4 soeng2 goi2 sing3。
text: 呢排愈嚟愈多女人結咗婚都唔想改姓。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do not make a noise when you eat soup.

jyutping: jam2 tong1 m4 hou2 jam2 dou3 syut4 syut2 seng1。
text: 飲湯唔好飲到𠽌𠽌聲。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't know where she lives.
I don't know where he lives.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 hai2 bin1 dou6 zyu6。
text: 我唔知佢喺邊度住。

author: kaenif

english.text: The man is old.

jyutping: go3 naam4 jan2 hou2 lou5。
text: 個男人好老。

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom had no money.

jyutping: Tom go2 zan6 mou5 cin2。
text: Tom嗰陣冇錢。

english.text: He said he knew the famous actress, which was a lie.

jyutping: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 sik1 dak1 go2 go3 ceot1 meng2 ge3 neoi5 jin2 jyun4，daan6 hai6 keoi5 gong2 gan2 daai6 waa6。

author: kaenif

english.text: You should prepare a room for the visitor.

jyutping: nei5 jing1 goi1 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 gaan1 fong4 bei2 fong2 haak3。
text: 你應該要準備間房畀訪客。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla was really scared.

jyutping: leoi5 laai1 zan1 hai6 hou2 geng1。
text: 蕾拉真係好驚。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It's not unprecedented.

jyutping: ni1 di1 gam3 ge3 si6 dou1 m4 hai6 mei6 faat3 saang1 gwo3。
text: 呢啲咁嘅事都唔係未發生過。

author: Akh2403

english.text: Sydney is better than Melbourne.

jyutping: sik1 nei4 hou2 gwo3 mak6 ji5 bun2。
text: 悉尼好過墨爾本。

author: Akh2403

english.text: My favourite colour is red.

jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 hung4 sik1。
text: 你最鍾意紅色。

author: clowergen

english.text: Do I have to do it right away?

jyutping: ngo5 sai2 m4 sai2 zik1 hak1 zou6 gaa3？
text: 我使唔使即刻做㗎？

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The UK's ruling regime has made the sudden decision not to recognize the GRCs of any country with laxer standards than the UK. Since it previously recognized the GRCs of such countries without issue, and since it only decided to do this after Scotland lowered its standards, the root of this decision can only be contempt for Scottish autonomy.

jyutping: jing1 gwok3 ge3 zap1 zing3 zing3 kyun4 dat6 jin4 kyut3 ding6 m4 sing4 jing6 jam6 ho4 biu1 zeon2 gang3 fun1 sung1 gwo3 jing1 gwok3 ge3 GRC 。jau4 jyu1 keoi5 zi1 cin4 sing4 jing6 ni1 di1 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 GRC hai6 mou5 man6 tai4 ge3，ji4 ce2 jau4 jyu1 keoi5 zi2 hai6 hai2 sou1 gaak3 laan4 gong3 dai1 biu1 zeon2 zi1 hau6 sin1 kyut3 ding6 gam3 zou6，so2 ji5 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ge3 gan1 jyun4 zi2 ho2 ji5 hai6 mit6 si6 sou1 gaak3 laan4 ge3 zi6 zi6。
text: 英國嘅執政政權突然決定唔承認任何標準更寬鬆過英國嘅 GRC 。由於佢之前承認呢啲國家嘅 GRC 係冇問題嘅，而且由於佢只係喺蘇格蘭降低標準之後先決定咁做，所以呢個決定嘅根源只可以係蔑視蘇格蘭嘅自治。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Until a little while ago, my schedule for next semester was looking really bad. But today I heard that there will also be nighttime chemistry classes, and I also learned that another physics class will be online. Looks like it'll be OK now, since there's no risk of having to go to two classes at the same time.

jyutping: zik6 dou3 cin4 jat1 zan6，ngo5 haa6 hok6 kei4 ge3 si4 gaan1 biu2 tai2 lok6 zan1 hai6 hou2 caa1。daan6 hai6 gam1 jat6 teng1 gong2 zung6 wui5 jau5 je6 maan5 ge3 faa3 hok6 baan1，tung4 maai4 ngo5 zung6 zi1 dou6 wui5 zoi3 hoi1 ling6 jat1 go3 mat6 lei5 baan1。tai2 lok6 ji4 gaa1 wui5 mou5 si6，jan1 wai6 mou5 fung1 him2 jiu3 tung4 si4 soeng5 loeng5 tong4。
text: 直到前一陣，我下學期嘅時間表睇落真係好差。但係今日聽講仲會有夜晚嘅化學班，同埋我仲知道會再開另一個物理班。睇落而家會冇事，因為冇風險要同時上兩堂。
